description: Browse memories with filtering and pagination. Supports sorting by creation date, update date, or title.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 point-in-time: return memories that were valid at this instant (bi-temporal). Defaults to currently-valid memories when omitted. Must be a full ISO-8601 timestamp (date + time + zone); a date-only or non-padded value is rejected to avoid a silently-wrong lexicographic slice.

department.description: Department (e.g., legal, engineering, hr, sales, finance)

document_type.description: Type of document (e.g., contract, policy, code, incident, decision)

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

offset.description: Skip this many results for pagination

name: memory_list
